links.surface: أم حبيبة بنت عرباض بن سارية

notes: Two sayings with their own isnads (owner ruling 6): the Prophet's prohibition through أم حبيبة and her father (a bare «أباها», so relation), and the Awza'i statement at the end, carried by «قال حدثني بذلك علي بن خشرم قال حدثنا عيسى بن يونس عن الأوزاعي»
The Awza'i group's last link is the Awza'i, whose words are the saying (rule 6); «الأوزاعي» stands three times in the text, so occurrence 3 is the one in the isnad
«قال أبو عيسى» remarks and «والعمل على هذا» are the compiler's comments, not links
tool_notes: saying 2: the opening stands before the saying's last link

groups.saying_opens: أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم نهى أن توطأ السبايا
إذا اشترى الرجل الجارية من السبى وهي حامل

notes: Saying 1 is the Prophet's prohibition, relayed by her father (أباها): a relation link, the Companion named only as her father in the nasab
Saying 2 is al-Awzaʿi's own ruling, with its own isnad «قال حدثني بذلك علي بن خشرم» (rule 4a); the compiler's «حدثني» is not written (rule 13)
«قال أبو عيسى» remarks and the Rufayʿ mention are the compiler's, not routes
